name: @tribunus/plugin — Capability-Scoped Extension SDK
description: Build the plugin SDK with capability governance. Plugins submit intents; Tribunus decides authority. Chrome-inspired declarative manifest with capability classes. Extension host process isolation. Full receipt trail for every authority-relevant action.
purpose: Enable third-party extensions without exposing raw database, filesystem, network, secrets, or shell access. Every plugin action is governed, receipted, and auditable.
acceptanceCriteria: Declarative plugin manifest with capability requests, contribution points, and trust metadata
Intent-based model: plugins submit intents, runtime decides authority
Six contribution categories: Tool, UI, Workflow, Data, Collaboration, Federation
Capability classes with scoped grants — never broad network:all
Extension host runs in isolated process, not Electron main
Every authority-relevant action produces a durable PGlite receipt
Revocation supports packages, publishers, signing keys, versions, and individual capabilities
